camel_example: aliyun esa ListSites --region cn-hangzhou --Status pending --OrderBy visitTime --SiteSearchType fuzzy --SiteName 'example.com' --PageSize 20 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-aekzd3styujvyei' --PageNumber 1 --TagFilter '[{"Value":"aaa","Key":"tag1"}]' --PlanSubscribeType basicplan --Coverage global --OnlyEnterprise false --AccessType NS
description_en: Queries the list of sites under the current user, including site names, statuses, and configurations
description_zh: 用于查询当前用户下的站点列表 ，包括站点的名称、状态、配置等信息
kebab_example: aliyun esa list-sites --site-name example.com --site-search-type fuzzy --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --tag-filter Value=aaa Key=tag1 --resource-group-id rg-aekzd3styujvyei --status pending --only-enterprise false --plan-subscribe-type basicplan --coverage global --access-type NS --order-by visitTime --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListSites

parameters.help_en: The site name. Used as a filter condition for the query
parameters.help_zh: 站点名称。用于查询的过滤条件
parameters.name: site_name

parameters.help_en:
The search matching mode for the site name. Default is exact match. Valid values:

prefix: prefix match.
suffix: suffix match.
exact: exact match.
fuzzy: fuzzy match
parameters.help_zh:
站点名称的搜索匹配模式。默认为精确匹配，取值：

prefix：前缀匹配。
suffix：后缀匹配。
exact：精确匹配。
fuzzy：模糊匹配
parameters.name: site_search_type

parameters.help_en: The page number for paging. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的页码。取值大于等于 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for paging. Valid values: 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的大小，取值范围 1-500
parameters.name: page_size

fields.help_en: The tag key. Used as a filter condition for the query
fields.help_zh: 标签键，用于查询的过滤条件
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value. Used as a filter condition for the query
fields.help_zh: 标签值，用于查询的过滤条件
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID. Used as a filter condition for the query
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID。用于查询的过滤条件
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The site status. Used as a filter condition for the query
parameters.help_zh: 站点状态。用于查询的过滤条件
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to query only Enterprise Edition sites. Set this parameter to true to query only Enterprise Edition sites
parameters.help_zh: 仅企业版，传true时代表仅查询企业版的站点
parameters.name: only_enterprise

parameters.help_en:
The plan subscription type. Valid values:
basicplan: Basic Edition.
standardplan: Standard Edition.
advancedplan: Premium Edition.
enterpriseplan: Enterprise Edition
parameters.help_zh:
套餐订阅类型。取值：
basicplan: 基础版。
standardplan：标准版。
advancedplan：高级版。
enterpriseplan：企业版
parameters.name: plan_subscribe_type

parameters.help_en:
The acceleration region. Valid values:
domestic: the Chinese mainland only.
global: global.
overseas: global (excluding the Chinese mainland)
parameters.help_zh:
加速区域。取值：
domestic：仅中国内地。
global：全球。
overseas：全球（不包含中国内地）
parameters.name: coverage

parameters.help_en:
The access type. Valid values:

NS: NS-based access.

CNAME: CNAME-based access
parameters.help_zh:
接入类型。取值：

NS：通过NS托管接入。

CNAME：通过CNAME接入
parameters.name: access_type

parameters.help_en:
The sort field. By default, results are sorted by creation time. Valid values:
gmtCreate: site creation time.
visitTime: site access time
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段，默认按照创建时间排序，支持
gmtCreate：站点创建时间
visitTime：站点访问时间
parameters.name: order_by

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned data

PageSize.description_en: The number of sites displayed per page

Sites.description_en: The list of queried site information
Sites.description_zh: 查询到的站点信息列表

AccessType.description_en:
The site access type. Valid values:

NS: NS-based access.
CNAME: CNAME-based access
AccessType.description_zh:
站点接入类型。取值：

NS：通过NS接入。
CNAME：通过CNAME接入

CnameZone.description_en: The CNAME suffix of the site. For sites that use CNAME-based access, this is the CNAME suffix that needs to be configured for records
CnameZone.description_zh: 站点的CNAME后缀。通过CNAME方式接入的站点，记录所需要配置CNAME的后缀

Coverage.description_en:
The acceleration region of the site. Valid values:

domestic: the Chinese mainland only.
global: global.
overseas: global (excluding the Chinese mainland)
Coverage.description_zh:
站点加速区域。取值：

domestic：仅中国内地。
global：全球。
overseas：全球（不包含中国内地）

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time of the site. The time is in ISO 8601 format and displayed in UTC. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
CreateTime.description_zh: 站点的创建时间，日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the plan attached to the site

NameServerList.description_en: The list of name servers assigned to the site. Multiple values are separated by commas (,)
NameServerList.description_zh: 站点分配的NS列表。使用半角逗号（,）分隔

OfflineReason.description_en:
The reason why the site is disabled. Valid values:

expiration_ arrears: The subscription plan has expired or the account has an overdue payment.
internally_disabled: The site is disabled by the system.
missing_icp: The domain name does not have an ICP filing.
content_violation: Content violation.
proactively_disabled: You proactively disabled the site or the site is disabled because the usage cap you configured is reached
OfflineReason.description_zh:
站点停用原因。取值：

expiration_ arrears：订阅套餐到期或账号欠费。
internally_disabled：被系统内部停用。
missing_icp：域名缺少ICP。
content_violation：内容违规。
proactively_disabled：您主动停用或您设置的用量封顶停用

PlanSpecName.description_en: The specification name of the site plan

Status.description_en:
The site status. Valid values:
pending: the site is pending configuration.
active: the site is activated.
offline: the site is offline.
moved: the site has been superseded
Status.description_zh:
站点状态。取值：
pending：站点待配置。
active：站点已激活。
offline：站点已下线。
moved：站点已被顶替

UpdateTime.description_en: The update time of the site. The time is in ISO 8601 format and displayed in UTC. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
UpdateTime.description_zh: 站点的更新时间，日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

VerifyCode.description_en: The site ownership verification code. When a site uses CNAME-based access, this TXT verification code must be configured
VerifyCode.description_zh: 站点归属校验码。当站点通过CNAME接入时，需要配置的TXT校验码

VisitTime.description_en: The access time of the site. The time is in ISO 8601 format and displayed in UTC. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
VisitTime.description_zh: 站点的访问时间，日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
